scope: Read and reuse the approved existing mini-truck/common blockout first. If absent or incomplete, coordinate continuation under td-198; no competing base or garage architecture worker.
Deliver original editable Blender source and game-ready export for one coherent small work-truck chassis, fixed paint zones, base plus two finishes and one compatible visible module demonstration.
Preserve approved axis/scale, wheel nodes, collider envelope and common bed-floor sockets. Module cannot block cab/window/lamps/tailgate/wheel travel or cargo readability.
Use cold-box prototype only as honest art/fit work until functional capability is supplied. Prefer existing accepted rack/padded fitting for eventual playable pairing.
Create matching reference/mock/3D views and baseline/after renders; record mesh/material/texture/triangle/memory budgets measured against the actual project.

visual_brief.skill_workflow: Use available 3dviz-pro-max visual iteration: genuine reference pixels → reviewed 2D mock → Blender model → matching render triptych → inspect/iterate → Godot import. Report unavailable skill/tool steps precisely.
visual_brief.quality_bar: Original mini-truck working silhouette; clean cab/bed relation and wheel centers; consistent proportions in every view; restrained cel-anime materials and readable rear upgrade.
visual_brief.excluded_shortcuts: No procedural placeholder sold as production model; no downloaded branded whole vehicle or copied mural; no beauty-only validation; no manufactured metrics.
visual_brief.effort_calibration: Substantial reference-led Blender authoring/reuse and corrective visual work, not a quick script. Exact estimate follows source/tool inspection.
visual_brief.evidence: Editable source/export manifest; triptychs, wireframes, Godot captures and budget results under owner-approved QA path.
visual_brief.merge_and_status: Draft PR only, author in_review; independent reviewer judges original pixels. No runtime hookup or self-acceptance.
visual_brief.standing_constraints: Opaque materials, original/licensed inputs, exact SHA and owner boundaries; current cel-anime direction supersedes obsolete sedan/PBR appearance.
